brief:
Egypt's President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi said Egyptian military support for Saudi Arabia will not include attacks on Yemen, the Palestine Chronicle reported. The statement came as Yemeni forces targeted Saudi military equipment and Saudi-backed troops reported an intensified offensive in the region.

Sisi clarified that Egyptian assistance would focus on defending Saudi territory rather than offensive operations across the border. The remarks set parameters around Cairo's involvement in the broader Saudi-led military campaign in Yemen.

title: Sisi rules out Egyptian strikes on Yemen amid Saudi tensions
